mapper.select: SELECT id, api_key_id AS apiKeyId, model_alias AS modelAlias, session_id AS sessionId, channel, expires_at AS expiresAt, created_at AS createdAt, updated_at AS updatedAt FROM router_session_binding WHERE api_key_id = #{apiKeyId} AND model_alias = #{modelAlias} AND session_id = #{sessionId} AND expires_at > CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3)
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO router_session_binding ( api_key_id, model_alias, session_id, channel, expires_at, created_at, updated_at ) VALUES (#{apiKeyId}, #{modelAlias}, #{sessionId}, #{channel}, DATE_ADD( CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3), INTERVAL #{ttlSeconds} SECOND ), CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3), CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3)) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE channel = #{channel}, expires_at = DATE_ADD( CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3), INTERVAL #{ttlSeconds} SECOND ), updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3)
